title: Bell integrated into the saucer airframe in 1944
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Bell integrated into the saucer airframe in 1944, about 1944 at Skoda Works, near Prague, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They took the rockets out, put the bell in it, and there's your flying saucer.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a writer and researcher, says that in 1944 at the Skoda Works, a large arms factory near Prague, the Nazis took the rockets out of a disc-shaped craft and put in the Bell, a secret power device said to have been built in their programme. In his words, that was your flying saucer. He points to a source called Closer Encounters, and if true, it would mean the flying saucer began as a wartime German weapon.
